results.title: Over 600 Nepali workers in Romania report pay and accommodation dispute
results.content: Workers allege that a Romanian logistics firm is offering lower wages than those promised in their contracts and seeking to charge them for accommodation that was supposed to be free.

results.title: Ayodhya-Janakpur train arrives with 1,000 passengers
results.content: The Saryu-Kamala Express was flagged off by the prime ministers of Nepal and India in New Delhi on Monday before departing from Ayodhya.

results.title: New Indian ports offer Nepal more options, but cost benefits remain unclear
results.content: Businesses in Birgunj say inland freight charges, rail links and transit arrangements will determine whether access to Paradip and Kandla lowers trade costs.

results.title: Government plans more ordinances before convening Parliament
results.content: The move is aimed at removing legal hurdles to projects to be showcased at an infrastructure conference in Kathmandu on December 9-10.

results.title: 5.6-magnitude earthquake strikes near Nepal-Tibet border
results.content: The earthquake was centred near Olangchung Gola in Taplejung district and struck at 7:17am on Tuesday. The EMSC put its magnitude at 5.3 and depth at 10km.

results.title: Inside one of Nepali cinema’s most enduring partnerships
results.content: Actress Rekha Thapa and director Shabir Shrestha have forged a rare creative partnership across eight feature films over 25 years. Ahead of their new film, the two look back on what has kept it going.

results.title: Longstanding disputes set aside, progress on development projects and economic aid
results.content: Nepal and India agreed on development projects and Rs240 billion in Indian assistance, while longstanding disputes remained unresolved.

results.title: Nepal, India agree to make Bhairahawa-Lucknow air route two-way
results.content: The agreement marks a breakthrough after 17 years of negotiations, but its implementation hinges on technical details, particularly the flight altitude India will permit over its airspace for aircraft approaching Bhairahawa.

results.title: When America sneezes, small economies catch a cold
results.content: Nepal is struggling to improve its trade performance as competition intensifies and global markets remain volatile.

results.title: PM Shah returns home after two-day state visit to India
results.content: The prime minister held high-level talks with his Indian counterpart and met Indian President Droupadi Murmu during his visit, which saw Nepal and India sign eight agreements covering various sectors.

results.title: Prime Minister Shah departs India after two-day state visit
results.content: Shah flew back to Kathmandu on a regular Nepal Airlines flight after holding talks with his Indian counterpart, and signing eight agreements covering areas including security, education, health and research.

results.title: Nepal and India PMs inaugurate 669MW Lower Arun project
results.content: The Rs92.67 billion hydropower project will use water discharged from the 900MW Arun-3 plant to generate electricity, but financial closure is still pending.

results.title: Shah invites Modi to visit Nepal, welcomes Indian investors
results.content: At a joint press conference in New Delhi, Nepal’s prime minister says the two countries have embarked on a development partnership as they launch the Ayodhya-Janakpur train service.

results.title: Nepal and India sign eight MoUs on cooperation in multiple sectors
results.content: Agreements cover forensic science, police training, civil service capacity building, satellite communications, health, urban development and traditional medicine.

results.title: Shah-Modi bilateral talks conclude in New Delhi
results.content: Senior ministers, security officials and top diplomats from both countries take part in the high-level discussions during the Nepali prime minister’s state visit to India.

results.title: Shah says compassion is ultimate strength in tribute to Gandhi
results.content: In a message at Raj Ghat, Nepal’s prime minister draws a parallel between Gandhi’s legacy and the values of Buddha, while reaffirming Nepal’s commitment to its enduring ties with India.
